messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock down the telemetry contract for the continuous queueing signals before next sprint. Core signals: batch size distribution, wait-time (p50/p95/p99), fill-rate, and saturation indicators. Goal: one ingest proto + dashboard template that runtime/infra/observability can implement. Who can own which piece?

maria: I can own the metric names + proto. I'll sketch something today. initial naming thoughts: `redwood.queue.batch_size.hist`, `redwood.queue.wait_time.ms.hist`, `redwood.queue.fill_rate.pct`, `redwood.queue.saturation.pct`.

sam: +1 to standardizing names. Two asks: (1) routing policy and model-variant tags so we can slice by route, (2) indicate whether the metric is per-pod or aggregated at dispatch layer.

lina: Dashboard/alerting owner here. We need semantics: are histograms the raw buckets or pre-aggregated summaries? Prefer raw buckets for UX (we can derive percentiles), but that increases ingest. Need options for sampled vs full.

chris: runtime note: microbatching + KV cache makes the observed batch_size distribution multimodal. If we only report mean + count we miss tail behavior. Histograms with fixed buckets (0-1,2-4,5-8,9-16,17-32,33-64,65+) would help. Also include `prefill` tag (true/false) to separate prefilled cache hits.

maria: good call. I'll include `route`, `model_variant`, `pod_id`, and `prefill` tags in the proto. Also adding a boolean `is_dedicated` for Dedicated vs hosted.

alex: routing policy matters for saturation metrics — if requests are routed to cheaper tiers, saturation may look higher upstream. We should include `route_policy` tag (`fast`, `cheap`, `fallback`) so dashboards can explain anomalies.

sam: regarding aggregation: infra should emit per-dispatcher aggregates every 10s and runtime should emit per-pod buckets every 1s. That gives us both real-time saturation signals and fine-grained batch distributions.

lina: For dashboards, plan: 1) real-time fill-rate + saturation chart (10s rollup), 2) batch_size distribution heatmap (1s rollup / 1m window), 3) wait-time percentiles with route/model split. Want a shared panel template so product teams can pin it.

devops-bot: CI check: telemetry-proto-lint passed for new fields (v0.3). link: https://ci.redwood/run/telemetry-proto-lint/512

oncall: question from oncall: what should alerts be? SRE wants a saturation > 85% for 2m or wait_time.p95 > 300ms for 5m. Are those reasonable?

chris: Those are reasonable starting points. Also add an adaptive alert: if fill-rate drops but dispatch errors increase, trigger high-priority. We'll need error tag linkage.

maria: proto snippet (rough):
```proto
message QueueBatchSignal {
  string route = 1;
  string model_variant = 2;
  bool prefill = 3;
  bool is_dedicated = 4;
  map<int32, int64> batch_size_buckets = 10; // bucket->count
  map<int32, int64> wait_time_ms_buckets = 11;
  double fill_rate = 12;
  double saturation_pct = 13;
  int64 ts = 20;
}
```

lina: That proto looks good. Only ask: make bucket keys consistent (e.g., bucket index strings) and include `sample_rate` metadata so observability knows how to rescale counts.

maria: will add `sample_rate` and `bucket_spec_version`.

alex: ops: owners agreed? maria -> metric names/proto, chris -> runtime instrumentation, sam -> infra aggregation contract, lina -> dashboard templates + alert rules, alex -> program manager + rollout UX coordination. We'll do a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize.

sam: I'll open the infra PR with the 10s/1s rollup details and example output schema.

chris: I'll prototype runtime emitter in a feature branch and include the `prefill` flag.

lina: I'll draft the dashboard panels and a short UX note on how to surface route_policy/model_variant with the rollout UI.

alex: Thanks all. Action items: maria proto v0.1 by EOD, sam infra PR by EOD+1, chris runtime spike by mid-week, lina dashboard draft before sync. Meeting: tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:

maria: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack :rocket:

chris: ack
